name: SESB SLDC Automatic Generation Control / load following interface
description: grid dispatch and AGC interface Primary source: https://ecos.gov.my/sites/default/files/uploads/para/attachments/2024-01/Sabah%20Grid%20Code.pdf

specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code CC5.3.5 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'The AGC command shall be sent via the transmittal of a "desired generation output level" signal from the SLDC and the plant controller will adjust the Generating Unit s output accordingly.' (value: desired generation output level signal sent from SLDC to plant controller)

Sabah Grid Code CC5.3.5 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Unless otherwise specified by the GSO, all Generating Units shall be equipped with appropriate plant controllers to participate in this AGC function.' (value: all Generating Units shall be equipped with appropriate plant controllers to par)

specifications.unit: seconds realisable; sustainable for next 30 minutes
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code OC3.4.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Secondary Reserve: ... under automatic generation control (AGC) or manually dispatch by GSO ... realisable within thirty (30) seconds ... sustainable for the next thirty (30) minutes.'

specifications.unit: seconds realisable; sustainable for next 25 seconds
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code OC3.4.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Primary Reserve ... realisable within five (5) seconds ... sustainable for the next twenty-five (25) seconds.'

Sabah Grid Code OC10 test list (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Before the Commercial Operation Date (COD), Generator and Power Park Module shall conduct the following tests ... x. Automatic Generation Control'. (value: Automatic Generation Control listed among tests before Commercial Operation Date)

Sabah Grid Code MC4.1.2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Operational Metering Data shall be collected by the Remote Terminal Units (RTUs) which are part of the GSO 's SCADA system.' (value: voltage, current, frequency, active/reactive power, plant status indications and)
where reference is made to CDGU, it applies to generating unit equal to or greater than 30MW if it is a synchronous unit
in the case of Power Park Module, it applies to total on-site generation capacity equal to or greater than 5 MW
Distribution Network The system operating at a nominal phase voltage of 33 kV or below
all references to specific dates shall be to the day commencing on such date at 00:00 hours, such time being Malaysian Standard Time (UTC/GMT + 8 hours)
The Grid System Operator or GSO is the person in SESB responsible for the overall coordination ... and is also responsible for generation Dispatch
